biography.value:
Tarterian dragons prowl the prison plane of Carceri, where the betrayers of the multiverse are kept. They are wardens and torturers, cold and spiteful, and they collect prisoners as other dragons collect coins. Their dark red scales bear chain-like markings.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .gK27tvqeYkdv8Lng]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .CKpCoO7CyZpKdK4c]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .V9rhqKZ9jYv8rm7y]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=8GGQEHVSQutCjDJG]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=8GGQEHVSQutCjDJG]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=8GGQEHVSQutCjDJG]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=EHHQe8Li4H7XHgPf]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Force Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a crushing wave of force in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=ni8wNwTUc7L40JdJ]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=ni8wNwTUc7L40JdJ]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=ni8wNwTUc7L40JdJ]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Imprisoning Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} unleashes its imprisoning Breath in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=Zl01I8Ow3DUWSPtT]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=Zl01I8Ow3DUWSPtT]] saving throw or be bound by chains of force, &Reference[restrained] for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the location of any creature it has restrained in the last 24 hours, as long as both are on the same plane.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Chains erupt from a surface within 120 feet; one creature within 10 feet of them must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be &Reference[restrained] until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • The exits of the lair seal with force until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • Each creature of the dragon's choice within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on saving throws until initiative count 20 on the next round.
